name: thekaiwa
description: TheKaiwa — AI 일본어 회화 훈련 앱 (Next.js 16 + Prisma 6 + Capacitor 7). 실행은 항상 ~/.node-local/thekaiwa 미러에서(NFS noexec).

scripts.dev: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev -p 3010
scripts.build: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build
scripts.test: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 $(find src scripts/seed-build -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
scripts.db:generate: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/.bin/prisma generate
scripts.db:push: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/.bin/prisma db push --skip-generate
scripts.db:validate: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/.bin/prisma validate
scripts.db:seed: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/.bin/prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed-base-words: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node --import tsx scripts/seed-base-words.ts
scripts.db:migrate-seed-copies: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node --import tsx scripts/migrate-seed-copies.ts
